definition: in a cool manner; coolly.
example_en: He answered coolly and walked away.

definition: the early stage of youth.
example_en: The prince in early youth learned horse riding.

definition: the front part of the neck; the throat.
example_en: They grabbed him by the throat with a fist and dragged him.

definition: the large, evergreen tree Hydnocarpus laurifolia ( = H. wightiana) of Flacourtiaceae family.
example: ಅವನ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುರಟಿ ಮರಗಳು ದಟ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿವೆ.
example_en: The Hydnocarpus trees have grown densely in his garden.

definition: to provide (a person) with knowledge, insight, etc.; to teach; to advice.
example: ಗುರು ತನ್ನ ಶಿಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಬುದ್ಧಿಗಲಿಸಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮಾರ್ಗ ತೋರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The teacher taught his disciples and showed them the right path.

definition: to immerse or soak in water or any other liquid.
example: ಬಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎದ್ದು ಬಿಡು.
example_en: Soak the cloth in water for a while.

definition: a vertical fold of a dhōti (a long loincloth worn by many men in India) or sari (sire, a garment worn by Indian women, consisting of a long piece of cotton or silk wrapped around the body with one end draped over the head or over one shoulder).
example_en: Grandmother folded the vertical fold of the sari carefully.

definition: to become black or dark.
example_en: Standing in the sun, his body became dark.

definition: an unpleasant, stale smell; rancid smell.
example_en: There was a stale smell in that old house.

definition: a man having neurosis; a neurotic.
example_en: That neurotic man was admitted to the hospital for treatment.

definition: the killing of a fetus; illegal abortion; foeticide.
example_en: Foeticide is a punishable crime according to the law.

definition: to become disorderly, chaotic, disorganised, etc.
example_en: Without a proper plan, the work becomes disorganised.

definition: to give an account of (happenings, etc.); to narrate; to give a statement.
example_en: He narrated the experiences of his journey.

definition: that which has a sweet sound; the Indian cuckoo (a long-tailed songbird of the family Cuculidae, which has a characteristic two or three-note call and deposits its eggs in the nests of crows which rear the young as their own).
example_en: The call of the Indian cuckoo was heard in the garden.

definition: a joining or being joined.
example: ಎರಡು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಕೂಡಣೆಯಿಂದ ಹಬ್ಬ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಸಂತಸಮಯವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The joining of the two families made the festival even more joyful.

definition: an erudite, scholarly woman; a learned, wise woman.
example: ಆ ಪಂಡಿತೆ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಶ್ಲೋಕವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That learned woman explained a Sanskrit verse at the assembly.

definition: the sound of bellowing (as of a bull, bison, pig, etc.).
example_en: The bellowing of the cattle came from the cowshed.

definition: the skin - a) the external covering or integument of an animal body, esp. when soft and flexible; b) such an integument stripped from the body of an animal; pelt: c) the tanned or treated pelt or hide of an animal, esp. when used in apparel and accessories; leather.
example_en: The skin around the wound had turned red.

definition: the act of a flower blooming.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಲಾಬಿಯ ಅರಲ್ಚು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: In the morning, the rose's blooming in the garden caught everyone's attention.

definition: a merciless, heartless, unpitying woman.
example_en: That merciless woman did not help the poor.

definition: the act of oozing, leaking out.
example_en: A leak of oil appeared at the base of the pot.

definition: the pea plant Lens culinaris ( = L. esculenta) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: Farmers grow the lentil plant in the field.

definition: any of several infectious diseases contracted from the other partner of sexual intercourse.
example_en: The doctor warned about the sexually transmitted disease.

definition: a kind of silk fabric.
example_en: She wore a silk saree of that fabric to the wedding.

definition: power; strength; might.
example_en: That warrior had immense power.

definition: a grating note, sound.
example_en: A grating sound was heard while opening the door.

definition: an earring with a hanging.
example_en: He is wearing a hanging earring.

definition: to look desolated, abandoned or deserted.
example_en: The dried-up field looks desolated.

definition: a chanting of the hymns of Sāmavēda.
example_en: The priests sang the Samaveda chant during the sacrifice.

definition: a line; a row.
example_en: The plants had been planted in a single row.

definition: the act of joining or uniting with.
example: ಎರಡು ಪಕ್ಷಗಳ ಸಂಗತ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಚುನಾವಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The joining of the two parties was seen in the local election.

definition: to become double; to increase twofold.
example_en: His salary doubled this year.

definition: boastful or useless talk; brag.
example_en: Hearing his boastful talk, everyone began to laugh.

definition: Ṣaṇmukha, who has six faces.
example_en: They worship Ṣaṇmukha with six faces in the temple.

definition: the act, fact of living; a living.
example_en: Even in poverty his living was full of happiness.

definition: a place, an area.
example_en: This place is very beautiful.

definition: knowledge acquired by systematic study in any field of scholarly application; learning.
example: ಆ ಪಂಡಿತನಿಗೆ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣದ ಬಿಜ್ಜೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That scholar knew the learning of grammar well.

definition: a bad, inauspicious moment.
example_en: One should not begin any work at an inauspicious moment.

definition: the hissing sound of a snake.
example: ಹಾವಿನ ಬುಸು ಕೇಳಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹೆದರಿ ಓಡಿದರು.
example_en: On hearing the snake's hissing, the children got scared and ran.

definition: a length of cloth used to wound in folds about the head, as a turban.
example_en: The grandfather adjusted his turban and set out.

definition: the creeper Cucurbita maxima of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The Cucurbita maxima creeper spread up to the roof of the house.

definition: a plant.
example_en: The kallukaraga plant has grown among the rocks.

definition: to comb and dress the hair.
example_en: The mother combed and dressed her daughter's hair.

definition: the deeds to be committed in the present life.
example: ಈ ಜನ್ಮದ ಆಗಾಮಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಜನ್ಮದ ಫಲ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The deeds committed in this life determine the fruit of the next birth.

definition: to go quickly by moving the legs more rapidly than at a walk; to run.
example: ಬಸ್ ತಪ್ಪುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಅವನು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗೊಂಡನು.
example_en: Fearing he would miss the bus, he ran quickly.

definition: the upper part of a woman's dress; a bodice; a blouse.
example: ಆಕೆ ಸೀರೆಯ ಜೊತೆ ಹೊಸ ಚೋಳಕ ಧರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She wore a new bodice along with the saree.

definition: an ornament worn around the ankle; an anklet.
example_en: The child's anklet was loose on her foot.

definition: to mix as to become or form into an emulsion; to emulsify.
example: ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಲ್ಕಂಗೂಡಿಸಿ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They mixed the oil and water well to emulsify them.

definition: Brahma.
example_en: In the puranas, Brahma is described as the creator.

definition: a dreadful famine, caused by dry weather, lack of rain for a prolonged period.
example_en: Due to lack of rain, a dreadful famine plagued that land.

definition: a woman belonging to the barberś caste.
example_en: That woman of the barber caste took part in the wedding.

definition: name of a demi-god.
example_en: Worship was held in the village for the demi-god Agasadabbe.

definition: to throw here and there or strew loosely; to scatter.
example_en: The wind scattered the papers on the table.

definition: an artist; a man - a) works in or is skilled in the techniques of, any of the fine arts, esp. in painting, drawing, sculpture, etc.; b) does anything very well, with imagination and a feeling for form, effect, etc.
example_en: That artist drew a beautiful painting.

definition: the tree Lagerstroemia lanceolata of Lythraceae family.
example_en: Lagerstroemia lanceolata trees have grown on the slope of the hill.

definition: the quality or condition of being clean, spotless; cleanliness; immaculateness.
example_en: The guests admired the cleanliness of the house.

definition: a leather strip.
example_en: They attached a leather strip to the sandal.

definition: a room, ward where child birth takes place; a labour-ward (as in a hospital).
example_en: They took her to the labour ward.

definition: to stack one above the other.
example_en: The books must be stacked one above the other carefully.

definition: a dry, barren, sandy region, naturally incapable of supporting almost any life; a desert.
example_en: The travelers crossed the desert on camels.

definition: a paying back (money); repayment (of a debt).
example_en: The repayment of the loan must happen on time.

definition: the plant Quercus lusitanica ( = Q. infectoria) of Gagaceae family.
example_en: The leaves of the oak gall plant are used for medicine.

definition: the mental disorder characterised by having apparent perception of sights that are not actually present or being inspired by false conceptions or fancy imaginations.
example_en: After the shock, madness developed in her.

definition: a piece of torn and ragged cloth.
example_en: The beggar wore a piece of torn and ragged cloth.

definition: the fish that is fit to be eaten.
example_en: Fresh edible fish was being sold in the market.

definition: a thief.
example_en: That thief broke into the house at night.

definition: to put forth branches; spread in or divide into branches; to divide or spread out into branches.
example_en: The young tree quickly put forth branches and grew.

definition: the act of cattle grazing or eating fodder.
example_en: The goats' grazing was going on atop the hill.

definition: Viṣṇu, whose vehicle is a bird.
example_en: The devotees prayed to Vishnu, whose vehicle is a bird, and bowed to him.

definition: a kitchen-vessel of metal, usu. broad, shallow, used for frying; a frying pan.
example_en: She heated the frying pan to make dosa.

definition: a male monarch of a major territorial unit, esp. one whose position is hereditary and who rules for life; a king.
example: ಆ ನೆಲಧೊರೆ ತನ್ನ ಸೈನ್ಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಟನು.
example_en: That king set out for war with his army.

definition: to cut off another's head; to behead; to decapitate.
example_en: The king beheaded the enemy.

definition: the plant Malpighia coccigera of Malpighiaceae family.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಸೀಮೆನೆಲ್ಲಿ ಗಿಡದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಔಷಧಿಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor used the leaves of the sīmenelli plant for medicine.

definition: an elephant in rut.
example: ಗಂಧದ್ವಿಪವು ಕೊಳದ ಬಳಿ ನಿಂತು ನೀರು ಚಿಮುಕಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The elephant in rut stood near the pond and sprayed water.

definition: in a small degree; to a slight extent; only slightly; not much; little.
example_en: Today it rained only slightly.

definition: the plant Curcuma longa of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: She ground the turmeric root for cooking.

definition: to lose enthusiasm; to be disheartened.
example_en: He was disheartened by the defeat.

definition: to crush; to squeeze.
example_en: He squeezed the lemon with his fingers.

definition: the act, fact or an instance of calling or summoning.
example_en: The priest chanted mantras for the summoning of the deity.

definition: the act or an instance of nodding one's head as in appreciation, satisfaction or approval.
example_en: Hearing the teacher's words, everyone nodded their heads in approval.

definition: to become larger; to increase in one's size; to enlarge oneself.
example_en: The business increased in size year after year.

definition: a single eye.
example_en: That bird had only a single eye.

definition: the act of tasting (a food item).
example: ಅಡುಗೆಯ ಸವಿಹ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಅವಳು ಉಪ್ಪು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: After tasting the dish, she adjusted the salt.

definition: the fact or an instance of appearing, being seen; appearance.
example_en: The appearance of that event surprised everyone.

definition: a bar used to prevent the wheel of a vehicle from turning esp. while going down a slope.
example_en: They attached the brake bar to the cart on the slope.

definition: foot coverings, as shoes, boots, slippers, etc.; footwear.
example: ಮನೆಗೆ ಬರುವ ಮೊದಲು ಕೆರವನ್ನು ಬಾಗಿಲ ಬಳಿ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಡು.
example_en: Leave your footwear near the door before coming into the house.

definition: deranged, uncombed hair.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಎದ್ದು ಅವನು ಜುಪರಿ ಕೂದಲನ್ನು ಬಾಚಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: After getting up in the morning, he combed his unkempt hair.

definition: the act of thinking deeply about; reflection; meditation; cogitation.
example: ಆ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಸಂಭಾವನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ.
example_en: Deep reflection about that problem is necessary.

definition: a tinge or a tint that renders a gem defective.
example_en: A tinge that spoils the gem is visible in that ruby.

definition: a portable shelter consisting of canvas, skins, etc. stretched over poles and attached to stakes; a tent.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಸಿಗರು ಕಾಡಿನ ಬಳಿ ಗುಡಾರ ಹಾಕಿ ಉಳಿದುಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: The tourists pitched a tent near the forest and stayed there.

definition: a running away from (facing defeat or fearing it); a retreating.
example_en: The king grew angry seeing the soldiers' retreat.

definition: the tree, Sapindus emarginatus ( = S. trifoliatus, S. lauriolius) of Sapindaceae family; soapnut tree.
example_en: The nut of the soapnut tree is used for washing hair.

definition: a flat nose.
example_en: That child's flat nose looked cute.

definition: the vine Piper longum of Piperaceae family.
example_en: They use the long pepper vine in Ayurvedic medicine.

definition: keenness and quickness in understanding and dealing with a situation; shrewdness; acumen.
example_en: Thanks to his acumen, the problem was solved quickly.

definition: the large, evergreen tree Poeciloneuron indicum of Guttiferae family, with darkish red wood, used for building construction, making railway sleepers, electric poles, etc.
example: ಬಲ್ಲಗ ಮರದ ಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಸ್ಲೀಪರ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The wood of the ballaga tree is used for railway sleepers.

definition: a strong bodied man.
example: ಆ ದಾಂಡಿಗ ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಭಾರವಾದ ಚೀಲವನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿದನು.
example_en: That strong-bodied man lifted the heavy sack all by himself.

definition: the condition of being fascinated; fascination.
example: ಆ ಚಿತ್ರ ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಅವನಿಗೆ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಕೊಸಱು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: When he saw that picture, he experienced a strange fascination.

definition: of perverse nature; slanting; following a crooked course; not straight or perpendicular.
example: ಅವನ ಕೋಚು ನಡತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His perverse, crooked behaviour annoyed everyone.

definition: the act of going up and up.
example_en: The continuous climbing of the hill tired him out.

definition: to be hallucinated; to have a false perception or conception; to be mislead.
example_en: Having lost his way in the dark, he became hallucinated.

definition: a follower of the doctrine which believes the world is made of and by the physical substances and not created by any god.
example_en: The materialist did not believe in God and worshipped nature itself.

definition: as usual; normally; in the normal or prevailing order, manner.
example: ಸಭೆ ಯಥಾಪ್ರಕಾರ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಹತ್ತು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The meeting began at ten in the morning, as usual.

definition: (fem.) a seller of betel leaves.
example_en: The betel leaf seller woman was selling betel leaves at the market.

definition: to cause to become solid, compact; to solidify.
example_en: They solidified the mud and made bricks.

definition: a room designed to store grain; a barn.
example_en: There was a barn behind the house.

definition: a piece of furniture to sit on; a seat, chair, stool, etc.
example_en: Grandfather was sitting on the stool.

definition: five times as much or as many (of something).
example_en: He asked for five times as much salary.

definition: the Supreme Being.
example_en: God protects everyone equally.

definition: a pair of eyeglasses, usu. in a frame, to help or correct faulty vision.
example_en: Grandfather needs eyeglasses to read.

definition: being two times of some quantity; twice as much, as many, as large, etc.; double.
example: ಇಂದು ನನ್ನ ಆದಾಯ ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ದುಪ್ಪಟ್ಟು ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Today my income has become double compared to last year.

definition: an open porch or portico, usually roofed, along the outside of a building; a verandah.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಆಲಿಂದದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ನಾವು ಮಳೆ ನೋಡಿದೆವು.
example_en: We sat in the verandah of the house and watched the rain.

definition: a conflict carried on by force of arms, as between nations or between parties within a nation; warfare, as by land, sea or air; a war.
example_en: Thousands of soldiers died in that war.

definition: magnificent splendour or glory; great grandeur.
example: ಆ ಅರಮನೆಯ ಕಡುಪೆಂಪು ನೋಡಿ ಜನ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: People were astonished seeing the great magnificence of that palace.

definition: a man wholly devoted to a god or religion.
example: ಆ ಆಂಡಾರಿ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಸೇವೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಜೀವನ ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That devout man spends his life in service to the temple.

definition: short stabbing-weapon with a pointed and edged blade; a dagger.
example_en: He stabbed the enemy with a dagger.

definition: a veil that covers only partially.
example_en: She came out of the house wearing a half-veil.

definition: bad effect.
example_en: Excessive medicine intake caused a bad effect.

definition: a projection at the bottom (as of an idol) made to fit into a corresponding cavity in the base to fix it (as the idol) firmly.
example_en: The sculptor carved a fixing projection at the base of the idol.

definition: to prosper; to thrive well; to flourish.
example_en: Owing to good rain, the crops flourished well.

definition: relating to Yama the God of Righteousness and Death.
example_en: The priests bowed towards the direction relating to Yama.

definition: the act of painting, smearing, daubing.
example_en: They gave the wall a coat of paint.

definition: (stammering) to affect a person while talking; to cause to stutter.
example_en: Out of fear his speech caught and he began to stutter.

definition: (dial.) a sense of loathing that a woman gets in the early stages of her first pregnancy.
example: ಮೊದಲ ಗರ್ಭದ ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಮೇಚಣಿಗೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: In the early stages of her first pregnancy she felt a sense of loathing.

definition: the state of being not aware of the surroundings.
example: ಗಾಢ ನಿದ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಸುತ್ತಮುತ್ತಲಿನ ಮರೆವು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: In deep sleep she became unaware of her surroundings.

definition: praised; lauded; commended.
example_en: His achievement was praised.

definition: an agreeing to; acceptance.
example_en: Both parties gave their acceptance to the agreement.

definition: a pot-bellied man.
example: ಪಿಚಂಡಿಲನು ತನ್ನ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಜನರ ಮುಂದೆ ನಾಚಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The pot-bellied man felt ashamed of his belly in front of people.

definition: a box, chest or case.
example_en: There are old letters in grandmother's chest.

definition: one that is antagonistic to another; an enemy; a foe.
example: ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಅಹಿತನಾಗಿ ಸದಾ ಕೇಡು ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is my enemy and always wishes me harm.

definition: that which has maxims, adages, etc. (as a book).
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥ ಸೂಕ್ತಿಗರ್ಭವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಅನೇಕ ಸುಭಾಷಿತಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ.
example_en: That book contains many maxims and is full of wise sayings.

definition: a man who has begotten a child; a father.
example_en: The father showed his son the right path.

definition: the quality or fact of (something) being secret.
example_en: No one came to know the secrecy of his plan.

definition: to feel deep sorrow or express it as by weeping or wailing; to wail; to lament.
example_en: The mother who had lost her son sat wailing.

definition: the neck of a person resembling a conch.
example_en: Her conch-like neck was adorned with ornaments.

definition: to cause to blow the chaff from (grain) by wind.
example_en: The farmer winnowed the paddy in the wind.

definition: a paint brush or a pen used for painting or wirting in different colours.
example: ಚಿತ್ರಗಾರ ಬಣ್ಣಗಂಬಿಯಿಂದ ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಕೆಂಪು ಬಣ್ಣ ಬಳಿದನು.
example_en: The painter applied red paint to the wall with a paint brush.

definition: a dispute or disagreement, esp. one marked by anger and deep resentment; a quarrel.
example: ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ತಂಟು ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A quarrel started between the two of them over a small matter.

definition: a lamp lit in the evening.
example_en: As soon as the evening lamp was lit, the whole house brightened.

definition: a boiling with bubbling sound.
example_en: A bubbling boil began in the pot.

definition: sink or subside under weight or pressure; to sag.
example_en: The middle of the cot sagged from the weight.

definition: a short film (as a documentary on a person, event or subject).
example_en: That director made a short film.

definition: the garden lizard,with an angular head, prehensile tail, eyes that move independently of each other, and a long, agile tongue for catching prey, known for its changing colour; a chameleon.
example: ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಕಾಟ ಬಣ್ಣ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A chameleon on the wall was changing its colour.

definition: a man who practices astrology; an astrologer.
example_en: The village astrologer fixed an auspicious time.

definition: an incident, event, person, thing etc. that causes mental agony.
example_en: His words caused me mental agony.

definition: the amount charged for mailing a letter or package etc.; postage.
example_en: She paid the postage required for the letter.

definition: accidentally; unexpectedly.
example: ಪೌವನೆ ಬಸ್ಸು ಕೈಕೊಟ್ಟು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ತಡವಾಗಿ ತಲುಪಿದರು.
example_en: The bus broke down unexpectedly and everyone arrived late.

definition: to set (a date, place, etc.).
example_en: They fixed the date for the wedding.

definition: to be.
example_en: God is present everywhere.

definition: a sum required to be paid as punishment or penalty for an offence; a fine.
example_en: A fine was imposed on him for breaking the rule.

definition: the tendency to be secluded from others; a being removed from crowd; aloofness; loneliness.
example: ಅವನ ಬಿಡುಗುಱಿತನದಿಂದ ಯಾರೂ ಅವನ ಸ್ನೇಹಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his aloofness, no one could get close to him in friendship.

definition: a very dim lamp.
example_en: In the darkness, the dim lamp gave only a little light.

definition: according to the principles of logic or correct reasoning; logical.
example_en: His argument, being logical, was accepted by everyone.

definition: the desire for revenge.
example_en: The desire for revenge was growing in his mind.

definition: the popped paddy.
example_en: They made popped paddy and distributed it for the festival.

definition: a taking of grocery items from a shop on credit; a credit purchase.
example_en: The shopkeeper used to give credit purchase facility to the poor.

definition: a block of stone kept or lying, across the way.
example_en: Because a stone block was lying across the path, it was difficult to walk.

definition: in football game, a player stationed at a goal to prevent the ball from entering it; a goal-keeper.
example: ನಮ್ಮ ತಂಡದ ಗೋಲಿ ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ತಡೆದನು.
example_en: Our team's goal-keeper blocked the ball well.

definition: the present day; today.
example_en: Let us start the new work today.

definition: outstandingly good of its kind; of exceptional merit, virtue, etc.
example_en: That horse is famed as being of an exceptionally good breed.

definition: (math.) a field having magnitude but not direction; scalar field.
example_en: The student learned about scalar fields in the lesson.

definition: brilliant light; effulgence.
example_en: The brilliant light of sunrise illuminated the whole sky.

definition: the cardamom plant Amomum subulatum of Zingiberaceae family; large cardamom.
example_en: Large cardamom has been used for this sweet dish.

definition: the act of striping (something) of its skin, rind, bark, etc.; the act of removing the clothing, outer covering of or from a person.
example_en: The peeling of the banana went easily.

definition: up to some extent.
example_en: His words were true up to some extent.

definition: manner or state of being; condition; circumstance.
example_en: She suffered greatly because of the condition of poverty.

definition: to wipe out, destroy completely; to eradicate.
example_en: The army completely destroyed the enemy's fort.

definition: to plunder; to pillage; to ransack; to loot.
example_en: The thieves plundered the village.

definition: a wooden oar for rowing a boat.
example_en: The boatman rowed the boat with the wooden oar.

definition: sugar cast into flat pieces; candied sugar.
example_en: Candied sugar is available at the shop.

definition: the advanced years of a person; old age.
example_en: Even though old age came, his enthusiasm did not diminish.

definition: the lower body or side.
example_en: The wound was on his lower body.

definition: a doubt; a suspicion.
example_en: There seemed to be a doubt in his words.

definition: an image or likeness of an object, person or scene produced on a flat surface, esp. by painting, drawing or photography; a picture.
example_en: They had hung a beautiful picture on the wall.

definition: (fig.) control of emotions, impulses; restraint.
example_en: Even in difficult times, he displayed control over his emotions.

definition: (masc.) a cheap, mean paramour who is a slave of his lover.
example: ಆ ಏಟವಿಟ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That mean paramour always agrees with whatever his lover says.

definition: to split into pieces.
example_en: He forcefully split the stick into pieces.

definition: one's eldest son.
example_en: The eldest son took over the administration of the kingdom.

definition: the act of kicking or a blow or thrust with the foot; a kick.
example: ಆಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಚೆಂಡಿಗೆ ಜೋರಾದ ಲತ್ತೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: In the game, he gave the ball a strong kick.

definition: a poetry composed impromptu.
example_en: The poet composed an impromptu poem before the assembly.

definition: a fabric of silk, nylon, rayon or the like having a smooth finish, glossy on the face and dull on the back; satin.
example_en: She came wearing a satin sari.

definition: a head having no hair; a completely bald head.
example_en: His bald head was shining in the sun.

definition: nearness; vicinity.
example_en: There is a school in the vicinity itself.

definition: something that is very simple or easy (to do, understand, solve, etc.).
example_en: Solving this sum was very easy for him.

definition: fine wheat flour.
example_en: Mother made a sweet dish from fine wheat flour.

definition: a shrinking from disgust; intense dislike or hatred; loathing; abhorrence.
example_en: He had abhorrence towards theft.

definition: the act or process of proving; a testing or trying of something.
example_en: A test of his honesty was carried out.

definition: any of a subclass (Hirudinea) of mostly flattened, annelid blood-sucking worms living in water or wet earth and having a well-developed sucker at each end; a leech.
example: ಕೆರೆಯ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಂಬುಳ ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿಗೆ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: A leech stuck to his leg in the lake water.

definition: the quality or condition of being negligent; habitual failure to do the required thing; carelessness in manner or appearance; negligence.
example_en: The work got ruined due to his negligence.

definition: tending to come or go downward; descending.
example_en: The sun was moving along its descending path towards the west.

definition: eagerness to know or learn; curiosity.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೌತೂಹಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.
example_en: Children have great curiosity about new things.

definition: intense grief.
example: ಮಗನ ಸಾವಿನಿಂದ ಆ ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಕಡುದುಗುಡ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The mother felt intense grief at the death of her son.

definition: one of the series of tooth-like parts, as on a saw, fork, rake, gearwheel, etc. as a tine, prong, cog, etc.
example_en: The teeth of the saw were sharp.

definition: a strong, powerful woman.
example: ಆ ಶಕ್ತೆ ಒಂದೇ ಸಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿದಳು.
example_en: That strong woman lifted the cart all at once.

definition: standing or positioned exactly opposite of.
example: ಅವನ ಮನೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದಿರು ಇದೆ.
example_en: His house is positioned exactly opposite to ours.

definition: a man whose duty is to inject a serum, vaccine, etc. into (a living organism), esp. in order to create immunity against a disease; an inoculator.
example_en: The inoculator gave the children their injections.

definition: to produce or cause to produce the ringing sound.
example_en: The temple bell rang out.

definition: to talk quietly or furtively, as in gossiping; to whisper.
example_en: They sat whispering about the examination.

definition: an accusing or being accused; accusation.
example_en: An accusation came against that clerk.

definition: a worker substituting or substituted for another.
example: ಅನಾರೋಗ್ಯ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅವನ ಜಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಯ್ಯಾಳ್ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: When he fell sick, a substitute worker came in his place.

definition: that is not possible; that cannot be achieved or understood; impossible.
example_en: Such an achievement is impossible for ordinary people.

definition: lack of discipline; indiscipline.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯ ಅಶಿಸ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಬೇಸರ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That student's indiscipline annoyed the teachers.

definition: the tree Aleurites triloba of Euphorbiaceae family; walnut tree.
example_en: We cracked open and ate the walnut tree's nuts.

definition: (collectively) the past history of events, happenings, etc. and their probable effects in future; antecedents (as of a person).
example_en: He explained the antecedents and consequences of that event.

definition: (phys.) the matter, tendency of which is to remain at rest if at rest or, if moving, to keep moving in the same direction, unless affected by some outside force; an inert object.
example_en: There was a book on the motionless, inert table.

definition: to withstand; to endure; to put up with; to tolerate; to bear.
example_en: He endured the hardships and moved forward.

definition: the outer side, part or surface; outside.
example_en: The outer surface of the cloth was very soft.

definition: the act of separating solid particles, impurities, etc. from a liquid passing it through a porous substance; filtering.
example: ನೀರಿನ ಗಾಳನ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಕುಡಿಯಬಹುದು.
example_en: After the filtering of water, it can be drunk.

definition: a king.
example_en: The great king sat upon the throne.

definition: the school of philosophy which holds that there are three distinct entities - the God, the individual soul and the world and these should not be identified as one and the same, and also advocates the Bhakti (devotion to the God) is the means of salvation.
example: ದ್ವೈತ ದರ್ಶನವು ಭಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಮೋಕ್ಷದ ಮಾರ್ಗವೆಂದು ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The Dvaita philosophy teaches devotion as the path to salvation.

definition: (pl.) the six flavours viz. salt, pungent, sweet, bitter, sour, astringent tastes.
example_en: Ayurveda says that balancing the six flavours is important.

definition: totalling one more than five; six.
example_en: I work six days in a week.

definition: any of the lotus plants.
example_en: Lotus flowers had blossomed in the pond water.

definition: in an intermediate space, position or function; between.
example: ಎರಡು ಮನೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಬಾವಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a small well between the two houses.

definition: a title 'a champion destroyer of the armies of enemies'.
example_en: People called him 'a champion destroyer of enemy armies'.

definition: a substance that exerts corroding or disintegrating action on the skin and flesh; caustic.
example_en: The workers used a caustic substance to purify the metal.

definition: (a respectable term used in addressing, esp.in plays) 'siṛ, 'gentlemaṇ.
example_en: In the play, they addressed him as 'sir'.

definition: a kind of folk song.
example: ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಅವರು ದಿಮ್ಮಿಸಾಲು ಹಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: While working in the field, they sang the folk song dimmisalu.

definition: quickly; swiftly.
example_en: The rain suddenly began to pour swiftly.

definition: to shine brightly.
example_en: The silver ornaments shone brightly in the light.

definition: a kind of potherb.
example_en: They served the navilumetti greens dish with the meal.

definition: to push forward oneself against the stroke of a weapon.
example_en: The warrior pushed himself forward against the enemy's sword-stroke.

definition: having limbs; consisting of parts.
example_en: This idol has been carved with all its limbs intact.

definition: any of various proteins, formed in plant and animal cells or made synthetically, that act as organic catalysts in initiating or speeding up specific chemical reactions esp. in fermenting liquors; an enzyme.
example: ಈ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ನಗ್ನಹು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This enzyme helps in the chemical reaction.

definition: lively, clever remark made in a sharp, amusing way.
example_en: Hearing his witty remark, the whole assembly laughed.

definition: totalling one more than six; seven.
example_en: There are seven children in that family.

definition: a woman who tends gardens; a gardener.
example_en: That woman gardener tends the flower garden well.

definition: a place of normal dwelling; a house.
example: ಅವನು ಊರ ಹೊರವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಇಕ್ಕರ ಕಟ್ಟಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ.
example_en: He got a house built on the outskirts of the town.

definition: an area of one square mile.
example_en: That forest extended over one square mile.

definition: a dam constructed across a river for storing and diverting water for irrigational purpose.
example_en: The farmers built a dam across the river for irrigation.

definition: the back part of the human foot, under the ankle and behind the instep; the heel.
example_en: While walking, his heel got injured.

definition: the act or profession of sweeping.
example_en: Sweeping is his livelihood.

definition: not aligned with either side in a conflict; non-aligned.
example_en: He remained non-aligned in this quarrel.

definition: to consider, cogitate carefully and in detail.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ದಾಯಗೊಳ್ಳದೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಡ.
example_en: Do not take a decision without considering this matter carefully.

definition: to persistently ask for more quantity or to lower the price, etc. to haggle.
example_en: He haggled asking to lower the price.

definition: lacking any definite order, system or discipline; not arranged properly; untidy; unsystematic; not methodical.
example_en: His room was untidy.

definition: to turn back from a straight line; to bend.
example_en: The tip of the creeper bent back on touching the wall.

definition: to scatter (water, perfume, etc.) in drops; to sprinkle.
example_en: She sprinkled water on the flowers.

definition: the woof or cross threads of a web.
example_en: The weaver put the crossweft into the cloth.

definition: (dial.) state of being thinly scattered; sparseness;
example_en: The sparseness of trees can be seen in the forest.

definition: a huge sword.
example_en: The hero had a huge sword at his waist.

definition: to hold the air taken into the lungs without exhaling.
example_en: His breath got held in fear (he held his breath in fear).

definition: a fluid or viscous substance used for writing or printing; ink.
example_en: The ink in the pen ran out and he could not write.

definition: a rat-trap.
example_en: They placed a rat-trap in the kitchen and caught the rat.

definition: the state or quality of being superior or higher, holier, venerable, better, etc. 2) a mystical power (as of a god, saint, etc.).
example_en: Everyone describes that great soul's venerable, superior quality.

definition: being without clothing or covering; nude; naked.
example_en: The ascetic was meditating with a naked body.

definition: to act, behave or follow the procedure, as per the established rule or custom.
example_en: He follows the customs of the elders.

definition: a fruit that is not fully grown; an unripe fruit.
example_en: The child ate an unripe fruit and hurt its teeth.

definition: not shaking; not trembling.
example_en: His hand, without trembling, aimed the arrow steadily.

definition: (masc.) one who desires, has a desire; a desirer.
example_en: The desirer strove to fulfill his wish.

definition: to become congruous; to have harmony, agreement or compatibility.
example_en: The thoughts of both became congruous.

definition: a woman considered in relation to her husband; a wife.
example_en: He came to the village with his wife.

definition: a man, not having required qualification or not being chartered, carrying on the profession of or acting as a lawyer or legal adviser.
example: ಪೂಟುಲಾಯರು ಎಂದು ಕರೆಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಆತನಿಗೆ ಸನದು ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The man called an unqualified lawyer had no license.

definition: to labour, perform service and get salary, wages, etc.; to earn.
example_en: She toiled in the field and earned her living.

definition: a hall or building where governmental deliberations are officially held; a court.
example_en: The panchayat meeting was held at the court hall.

definition: the cardinal number fifty.
example_en: Fifty people had come to that meeting.

definition: the state or quality of being gay; gaiety; cheerfulness.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಡಿಂಗು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: On the festival day, cheerfulness showed on the children's faces.

definition: a series of small bell for the ankles; (?).
example_en: The dancer tied the anklet bells and danced.

definition: to beat, to strike heavily and repeated with a large pestle in a mortar.
example_en: She was pounding the paddy with a pestle.

definition: a line, stroke written with a pen, pencil, brush, etc. on a surface.
example: ಅವನು ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಬರೆ ಎಳೆದನು.
example_en: He drew a line on the book.

definition: the act or an instance of exchanging blows with fists mutually.
example_en: A fistfight took place between the two boys.

definition: a sympathising or sympathetic tendency.
example: ಬಡವರ ಕಷ್ಟ ಕಂಡು ಅವಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮರುಕೆದೆ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the suffering of the poor, sympathy arose in her.

definition: a conflict, strife or contention.
example_en: He did not lose in the struggle of life.

definition: to clear (something) of impurities; to clean.
example_en: She cleaned the cloth of impurities well and dried it.

definition: the visible gaseous substance released by a burning object; smoke.
example_en: Smoke had filled inside the hut.

definition: a losing or being lost; loss.
example_en: They calculated the loss of the shop.

definition: the state of being a father; fatherhood; paternity.
example: ಮಗು ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅಪ್ಪತನದ ಅನುಭವವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After the child was born, he experienced fatherhood.

definition: an appropriate time.
example_en: Fix the wedding time by looking at an appropriate occasion.

definition: to stand aloof.
example_en: He stood aloof from that quarrel.

definition: a bad, evil, base or wicked thought or matter.
example_en: Wicked thoughts filled his mind.

definition: (fem.) a professional snake-charmer or catcher.
example_en: The female snake-charmer took the snake out of the basket.

definition: to become pale; to lose lustre.
example: ಬಹಳ ದಿನ ರೋಗದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮುಖ ಕಳೆಗಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: After many days of illness his face lost its lustre and became pale.

definition: the central place or portion.
example_en: The temple is in the central place of the village.

definition: employment of mystical or vedic hymns for the right end.
example_en: He cured the patient through the employment of mystical hymns.

definition: a man who speaks fluently and well; an eloquent speaker.
example_en: Everyone admired the words of the eloquent speaker.

definition: the attitude of the mind with which things are views and judged; view-point.
example: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರ ದೃಕ್ಕೋಣ ಈ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Everyone's viewpoint on this matter was different.

definition: to hang some thing as to have a free movement at the bottom; to suspend.
example_en: He suspended the rope from the wall so it hung freely.

definition: deep trouble or misery.
example_en: He suffered greatly from the deep trouble of debt.

definition: to include, contain (without oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This law includes all citizens.

definition: that which is torn.
example_en: He threw the torn piece into the trash bin.

definition: a man who is co-habiting with another.
example_en: Her live-in partner lived in the neighboring house.

definition: a male dog.
example_en: The male dog ran along the street barking.

definition: the strap of a horsṛs harness passing from the noseband to the girth between the forelegs, to keep the horse from rearing or throwing back its head: martingale.
example_en: The horse's martingale strap was fastened tight from the noseband to the girth.

definition: the tree, Juglans regia of Juglandaceae family.
example_en: People eat the seeds of the akkhola tree.

definition: that which supports; a prop; a stay; a support.
example_en: This wall needs a support.

definition: the control exercised by the state in distributing, selling etc. of food items, esp. essential ones that are relatively scarce; food control.
example_en: The government enforced food control during wartime.

definition: the beauty of the body.
example_en: The poet described the beauty of her body.

definition: the unclean matter accumulated on the skin when the sweat gets evaporated.
example_en: As the sweat dried, grime accumulated on the body.

definition: to strike with beak or with a pointed object; to peck.
example_en: The bird pecked and broke the seed.

definition: the acquiring of knowledge or skill; learning.
example_en: Children need good education.

definition: the physical body (of a human being).
example_en: The physical body is merely an instrument for the soul.

definition: by that time; (just) before that point of time.
example_en: By that time he had already reached the village.

definition: a discharging or removing or being discharged or removed from office or service, etc.; dismissal; removal.
example_en: The order of dismissal came for that clerk.

definition: a minister in the council of a king.
example: ಆ ರಾಯವಜೀರ ರಾಜನಿಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡಿದ.
example_en: That minister of the council gave the king good advice.

definition: a wealthy man.
example: ಅವನು ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಧನಾಢ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
example_en: He is famous in the town as a great wealthy man.

definition: the end; finish; conclusion; finis.
example: ಈ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಎರಡು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಗಳ ವಿವಾದದ ವಿನಿವೃತ್ತಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: This agreement caused the conclusion of the dispute between the two nations.

definition: the tree Clerodendrum phlomidis of Verbenaceae family.
example_en: A Clerodendrum phlomidis tree has grown near the fence.

definition: the plant Malva verticillata of Malvaceae family.
example_en: The Malva verticillata plant grows on its own in the open field.

definition: a baking of (a food item) on a pan.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಒಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ರೊಟ್ಟಿಯ ಹಂಚುರಿ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother baked the rotti on the pan over the stove.

definition: a young dog; a puppy.
example_en: That puppy was playing in the courtyard.

definition: the act of thinking seriously and deeply about; a pondering, meditation.
example: ಆತ ಜೀವನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗಂಭೀರ ಚಿಂತನ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: He engaged in serious contemplation about life.

definition: to change one's status, position, condition, etc.
example_en: His health condition changed due to the medicine.

definition: (Jain.) transferring of one's wealth, and the effects of one's virtues to his own son or an adopted son with a view to making the lineage growing for ever.
example: ಜೈನ ಗೃಹಸ್ಥನು ಅನ್ವಯದತ್ತಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಆಸ್ತಿ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The Jain householder transferred his property to his son through anvayadatti.

definition: the act or an instance of running.
example_en: The running of the waterfall from the hill went on continuously.

definition: (pl.) three kāsu (an old monetary unit).
example: ಅವನು ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ವಸ್ತುವಿಗೆ ಮೂರುಕಾಸು ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He paid three kāsu for that old item.

definition: a variety of acacia tree.
example_en: The shade of the acacia tree was cool.

definition: a thin quilt filled with cotton.
example_en: Mother got a new cotton-filled quilt stitched for winter.

definition: to pull (as the string of a bow).
example_en: The archer pulled the bowstring forcefully.

definition: carbon in its pure, extremely hard and crystallised (in isometric system) form; diamond.
example_en: This ring has a rare diamond in it.

definition: to find out or estimate the extent, dimensions, etc. of, esp. by the use of a standard; to measure.
example_en: He measured the length of the cloth and cut it.

definition: one who stabs.
example: ಆ ಇಱಿಗಾಱ ಬಜಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬನನ್ನು ಚಾಕುವಿನಿಂದ ಇರಿದನು.
example_en: That stabber stabbed a man with a knife in the market.

definition: the tree Symplocos racemosa of Symplocaceae family.
example_en: The Symplocos racemosa tree grows on the hill.

definition: (sing.) the pronoun of the second person used of the person being addressed; you; thou.
example_en: Where are you going today?

definition: the act or process of transferring.
example_en: The transfer of the property took place at the office.

definition: the cardinal number one hundred; 100.
example_en: There were a hundred rupees in that bag.

definition: an arrow with a crescent-head.
example_en: The warrior strung the crescent-headed arrow on his bow.

definition: great festive mood; alacrity; conviviality.
example_en: During the festival, the whole town was filled with festive joy.

definition: the science of numbers; arithmetic.
example_en: The arithmetic lesson began for the schoolchildren.

definition: a particular hold in wrestling.
example_en: The wrestler won by applying the melmuli hold on his opponent.

definition: a boy.
example_en: The boy was playing with friends on the street.

definition: a role of cloth measuring totally forty yards.
example_en: I bought one roll of cloth at the shop.

definition: to become solid, compact, etc.; to solidify.
example_en: After drying, the brick becomes solid.

definition: to give a name or title to; to name.
example_en: The father named the child Rama.

definition: the quality or condition of being dwarf, shorter or smaller than the usual one of one's species; shortness; dwarfishness.
example_en: His dwarfishness appeared special to the children.

definition: anything that is worn to look good or to enhance the beauty; an ornament.
example_en: The ornament on her neck glittered with pearls.

definition: a poetical work; poetry.
example: ಕವಿ ಆ ಕಬ್ಬವನ್ನು ರಾಜನ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಠಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet recited that poetical work in the king's court.

definition: a treaty - a) a formal agreement between two or more nations, relating to peace, alliance, trade, etc.; b) the document embodying such an agreement.
example_en: A treaty was arrived at between the two kingdoms.

definition: (in comp.) a woman who destroys or domolishes; a destroyer.
example_en: That destroyer woman destroyed the enemy army.

definition: of, including, involving, consisting of more than one; plural.
example_en: This word denotes the plural number.

definition: a home, refuge; resort.
example_en: This house alone was a refuge for that old man.

definition: a melodious sound or tone.
example_en: A melodious tone spread everywhere from the flute.

definition: Anjanādri, the black mountain.
example_en: The pilgrims set out to climb the black mountain.

definition: that which is established or firm, as a steadfast decree, statute ordinance or law.
example_en: Upholding truth is the duty of a person.

definition: a cylinder of wood or metal, over which something is rolled for easier movement; a roller.
example: ಮರದ ದಿಮ್ಮಿಯನ್ನು ಉರುಟಾಣಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಉರುಳಿಸಿ ಸಾಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They rolled the wooden log over a roller and moved it.

definition: to give life to.
example: ಆ ಔಷಧಿ ಸತ್ತಂತಿದ್ದ ಸಸಿಗೆ ಆಯ್ಪೊಯ್ಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That medicine gave life to the seemingly dead sapling.

definition: (a sharp feeling of uneasiness brought on by a sense of guilt or a feeling of slight regret for something done) to occur in the mind.
example: ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಕಚ್ಚೆನಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After telling the lie, he felt a strong pang of guilty unease.

definition: to eject, spit out; to vomit.
example_en: As the food did not suit him, he vomited it all out.

definition: a horn-shaped metal trumpet; a bugle.
example_en: The soldiers blew the bugle and began the battle.

definition: any of the storeys above the ground floor of a building; upstairs.
example_en: Old books are kept upstairs.

definition: money spent unnecessarily; wasteful expenditure.
example_en: If unnecessary expenditure is reduced, savings will increase.

definition: he who lends money; a lender.
example_en: That lender gives money on interest.
